title: Towards NNGP-guided Neural Architecture Search
summary: Turns our NNGP-guided NAS release — using NNGP validation accuracy on NAS-Bench-101 models over CIFAR-10 subsets as a cheap performance predictor, with quality metrics like Kendall's Tau and PQETP — into an architecture pre-screening service that cuts wasted full-training runs in search workflows.
